decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. The design and appearance of the building, due to its flat roof, use of materials and fenestration details, would be bland and architecturally uninspiring, out of characterwith the prevailing pattern of development in the area, in this prominent location. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policy ENV.B.1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan Review Deposit 1999.

Condition : 2 - The proposal, due to the submission of inadequate information, fails to demonstrate that there will be no undue impact on the character of the River Thames. The plans also fail to show the location of the building in relation to the High Street, highway and adjacent park area, consequently the impact of the building on the street scene cannot be accurately assessed. In the absence of further details, it is considered that the proposals would give rise to a development in an unsuitable location which in turn, would have a detrimental effect on the character and amenity of the locality and the setting of the River Thames, and would also be contrary to Policy ENV.1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policy ENV.B.1.1 of the Unitary Development Plan Review Deposit 1999.
